author: Kusha N M
raw:
ತನನೋವೆ ಹಿರಿದೆಂದು ಭಾವಿಸುವ ಮಾನವನು
ಅನವರತ ಪರರಿಂದ ಕರುಣೆ ಬಯಸುವನು
ಅನುಭವಕೆ ಬರುತಲಿರೆ ಅನ್ಯಜನ ಕಷ್ಟಗಳು
ಮನಮಿಡಿದು ಮರುಗುವನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: A man who thinks his own pain is the greatest
keeps looking to others for pity;
when he comes to experience the hardships of other people,
his heart is moved and he grieves for them, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We tend to think our own suffering is the worst and want sympathy. Only when we truly see others’ pain does real compassion awaken.
